_comment: Every simulation system in the ONI simulation platform: what the game already has and what the platform adds, with its status, layer, milestone and what it is built on.

systems.name: Heat transfer and conduction
systems.summary: Neighbouring cells and buildings exchange heat by a pair conductivity; the replacement library reproduces the game's own kernel bit for bit.
systems.divergence: none: matches the game's own library (checked against it scenario by scenario)

systems.name: Element phase change by temperature
systems.summary: A cell turns into its low or high transition element when it crosses a fixed temperature, whatever its pressure or mass.
systems.divergence: Real phase change depends on pressure and costs latent heat; see phase pressure and latent heat in the other column

systems.name: Condensation rain
systems.summary: A condensing gas cell over open space becomes a falling drop instead of condensing in place; the replacement reproduces it and the vanilla library's mass ledger books it.
systems.divergence: none: it is the game's own behaviour, found missing and matched

systems.name: Gas and liquid pressure as mass per cell
systems.summary: Pressure is the mass a cell holds: gas moves from heavier to lighter cells and one element holds each cell; a deeper liquid cell simply holds more mass.
systems.divergence: No ideal-gas law, no depth pressure; the platform adds both (gas mixtures, hydrostatics)

systems.name: Germs and disease
systems.summary: One disease per cell that grows, dies and spreads by the element it rides; where two meet, one is destroyed.
systems.divergence: One disease per cell; the platform adds several per cell (opt-in)

systems.name: Radiation (Spaced Out)
systems.summary: A radiation field from emitters, absorbed by the matter it passes through.
systems.divergence: none: matches the game's own library

systems.name: Conduit flow (pipes)
systems.summary: Each pipe tile holds one packet of one element with a mass and a temperature, moved tile by tile; a packet past its transition temperature damages the pipe.
systems.divergence: No volume or pressure in a pipe; the platform adds them (pipe pressure)

systems.name: Decor
systems.summary: Buildings and objects spread a decor value over the cells around them, which duplicants' morale reads.
systems.divergence: none: game code, not part of the simulation library; left as the game has it

systems.name: Power grid
systems.summary: Generators, wires and batteries supply buildings' power draw; in the base game that draw becomes no heat.
systems.divergence: Power draw deletes its energy; Mod 1 turns it into heat in the building

systems.name: Automation signals
systems.summary: Green/red logic signals on automation wire drive the game's buildings through their automation inputs.
systems.divergence: Binary signals only; Mod 5 adds IC10 programs that read and write values

systems.name: Rockets
systems.summary: Rockets built from modules travel between asteroids and carry crew and cargo.
systems.divergence: none yet: Mod 3's lander is built from the game's own rocket parts, and Mod 4 plans to extend them rather than replace them

systems.name: World generation
systems.summary: Asteroids are generated from Klei's world and template YAML: biomes, geysers, ruins, critters.
systems.divergence: Mars is a world of its own through the same pipeline, with no geysers or ruins

systems.name: Latent heat: real phase-change energy
systems.summary: Every seeded substance carries its real latent heats of vaporisation and fusion; Mod 1's pipes, chambers and tanks pay and release them when matter changes phase.
systems.divergence: Values from NIST reference data; Pollutant keeps the values of the Stationeers gas it is modelled on
systems.replaces: the instant temperature-only phase swap: a cell or pipe changes element with no energy paid

systems.name: Material properties registry
systems.summary: Molecular mass, vapour-pressure curve, lowest liquid pressure, critical point, heat-capacity ratio and liquid density per substance, readable and extendable by any mod.
systems.divergence: Klei's element table has none of these; it stores atomic mass for diatomic gases, the registry the real molecular mass

systems.name: Phase pressure: no liquid below its pressure
systems.summary: A gas may only condense at or above its lowest liquid pressure (CO2 517 kPa), so Mars' 2.47 kPa air never rains liquid CO2; in pipes, a liquid boils when the headspace pressure puts its boiling point below its temperature.
systems.divergence: MATCH: Stationeers lets a gas condense only at or above its lowest liquid pressure, and so do we; the game's own test is temperature only
systems.replaces: condensation and boiling by temperature alone

systems.name: Heat goes somewhere
systems.summary: Power draw, exhaust heat, the Steam Turbine, generators and the Wheezewort put their heat into a real destination instead of deleting it; the rules are in the framework.
systems.divergence: Departs from the base game, which deletes this energy
systems.replaces: power draw that becomes no heat; the Steam Turbine, Wheezewort and AETN deleting heat

systems.name: Small heat payments land in full
systems.summary: A cell keeps the remainder of a heat payment too small for one temperature step and applies it with the next; off by default, Mod 1 switches it on.
systems.divergence: Off is the game's own arithmetic
systems.replaces: heat payments too small for one temperature step, silently dropped

systems.name: Gas mixtures: several gases per cell
systems.summary: A mixture layer holds each gas's own mass in a cell, all adding to the pressure, and moves each down its own partial-pressure gradient; mixed temperatures blend by heat capacity.
systems.divergence: Stationeers-style per-cell atmosphere; the game holds one element per cell

systems.name: Breathing by oxygen partial pressure
systems.summary: Breath is graded by oxygen partial pressure, carbon dioxide is a poison above 0.5%, and air temperature can damage lungs.
systems.divergence: The base game grades breathing by the oxygen element alone
systems.replaces: breathing by the oxygen element alone

systems.name: Pipe pressure, stress and burst
systems.summary: Each pipe network has a volume, a pressure (ideal gas law, or fill for liquids) and a phase; past its rating a pipe takes damage and an overpressure burst vents the line, and gas condenses or freezes inside it with its latent heat.
systems.divergence: Tooltip follows Stationeers'; a gas far above its critical point can still report a condensation temperature (open item)
systems.replaces: pipes that hold mass packets with no volume or pressure

systems.name: Gas dissolved in liquid, and bubbles
systems.summary: Liquids carry dissolved gas through pumps, pipes, storage and bottles; released gas forms bubbles that rise, grow and trade heat with the water.
systems.divergence: The base game deletes the 1 kg of CO2 per soda; a drink here holds a real 40 g
systems.replaces: the Soda Fountain deleting 1 kg of CO2 per drink

systems.name: Refrigeration cycle
systems.summary: A vapour-compression cycle: a working fluid boils in the cold room, is pumped to the hot side, condenses there and returns; only the fluid crosses and every joule is booked.
systems.divergence: The doc read does not compare it with Stationeers' air conditioner
systems.replaces: the Thermo Aquatuner and Thermo Regulator's fixed -14 K step

systems.name: Mass and energy ledgers
systems.summary: Every mass and energy change in a frame is booked to a named bucket, so a mod's change can be shown to conserve.
systems.divergence: none: Klei's library has no ledger

systems.name: Mars atmosphere, day and night, planetary thermostat
systems.summary: The simulation side: a CO2 sky at 2.47 kPa refilled by the planet, a 220-293 K day/night ambient, sunlight and sky radiation, and latent heat from sky condensation folded into the planet's temperature.
systems.divergence: Range and thermostat MATCH Stationeers' Mars: the planet refills its sky and holds its own temperature band; Mod 3, which drives it, is in development (see Mars world)

systems.name: Generic field solver
systems.summary: A field, a propagation rule and per-material attenuation declared as parameters. Not yet confirmed in a release.
systems.divergence: not yet compared with Stationeers in a public document

systems.name: Falling liquid keeps what flowed into it
systems.summary: When a liquid cell starts to fall, liquid that flowed into it earlier in the step stays in the cell instead of being deleted; on by default.
systems.divergence: The first default that departs from the game's own library (a setting restores the game's behaviour)
systems.replaces: falling liquid deleting what flowed into its cell earlier in the step

systems.name: Liquid depth pressure (hydrostatics)
systems.summary: Liquids keep their real density, pressure rises with depth, connected bodies level out by pressure and a sealed body can siphon; off by default.
systems.divergence: Levels out but no waves yet (H5 is planned)
systems.replaces: liquid pressure as mass per cell, with no depth

systems.name: Several diseases per cell
systems.summary: Up to eight diseases share a cell when a mod switches it on, ride gas and liquid and are saved with the world.
systems.divergence: Stationeers has no disease; the vanilla rule stays the default
systems.replaces: one disease per cell, the loser destroyed

systems.name: Odour field
systems.summary: A three-channel odour property that moves with the air, spreads, fades and is saved.
systems.divergence: New feature; Stationeers has no odour field

systems.name: Grime and hygiene
systems.summary: Duplicants get grimy, which slows them; showers clean them; grime smells and others react to it.
systems.divergence: Shape MATCHES Stationeers' hygiene stat (convergent, not a port): grime builds with activity and washing clears it; rates are our own

systems.name: Smoke: conserved airborne particulate
systems.summary: Gas carries particulate that moves with it, conserved, and settles out as a deposit; an idea by Kaz.
systems.divergence: Stationeers has no soot or deposits; particulate alongside Pollutant is a signed PREFERENCE

systems.name: Combustion: fuel + oxidiser, products, heat
systems.summary: Fuels burn by their composition, drawing oxygen from the cells around them; products, soot and heat all land somewhere, and gas fires ignite, spread and drown in water.
systems.divergence: Ignition MATCHES Stationeers: each cell tests its own fuel, oxidiser and temperature; two signed PREFERENCE divergences (pace, premixed flash)
systems.replaces: generators and the Campfire turning fuel into fixed outputs by recipe

systems.name: Mixture rooms: conduction, stirring, dew-point condensation
systems.summary: A room run by the mixture layer trades heat with its walls and liquid, stirs at equal pressure, and condenses steam by its partial pressure.
systems.divergence: none recorded in the doc read

systems.name: Ideal-gas thermal model
systems.summary: Hot gas expands into cooler gas of its own kind by an ideal-gas pressure model; off by default.
systems.divergence: An even-temperature world is identical to the game's

systems.name: Falling liquid trades heat in flight
systems.summary: Falling liquid exchanges heat with the gas it falls through and can boil away or freeze in flight, never taking more heat than the gas holds.
systems.divergence: none recorded in the doc read

systems.name: Levelled pipe lines and saturation-capped boiling
systems.summary: Lines a tank or pump looks after hold one temperature and one gas mixture along their length and carry germs; a liquid line boils only until its headspace is saturated.
systems.divergence: One state per network MATCHES Stationeers' pipe networks; the boiling cap MATCHES its rule that a liquid boils only until the headspace is saturated; per-tile storage is STRUCTURAL (ONI pipes hold packets per tile)

systems.name: Payloads carried by liquid (sugar)
systems.summary: Any liquid-borne property a mod registers travels with its liquid through pumps, pipes, storage and bottles; the Mash Tun's sugar is the first.
systems.divergence: Yeast fermentation instead of Stationeers' fixed-recipe Fermenter (for the planned F3)

systems.name: Determinism digest
systems.summary: A per-frame digest of the world's state and a tool that finds the first frame where two runs differ; for testing, not for play.
systems.divergence: none: new tooling

systems.name: Mars world (Mod 3)
systems.summary: Mars generates as its own world; the colony lands in a crippled rocket and must build refrigeration to leave. In development; not in a release yet.
systems.divergence: Values from Stationeers' Mars and real data

systems.name: Deterministic lockstep multiplayer
systems.summary: Co-op on one colony: every PC runs the same simulation in 200 ms turns and only orders travel; a digest every few seconds catches drift. In development, with prediction and rollback.
systems.divergence: Runs on the game-identical library, so none of the new simulation is in it yet

systems.name: Performance mod and fast loading
systems.summary: Changes to the game's own code, each behind a switch, plus loading a very large colony about five times faster. The first set was released alongside Alpha 2 under Salacious-Oni-Mods (fast loading ships switched off); more is in development.
systems.divergence: none: not a simulation change

systems.name: Garbage-collection stutter
systems.summary: A rebuilt runtime that marks memory on several threads (pause about 220 to 42 ms) and a mod that times collections. Released alongside Alpha 2 under Salacious-Oni-Mods.
systems.divergence: none: not a simulation change

systems.name: IC10 programmable automation
systems.summary: The IC Housing runs IC10 programs (all 154 instructions) against buildings on a data cable, reading and driving vanilla and physics-mod buildings. Released in Alpha 2 with AI placeholder art.
systems.divergence: The language MATCHES Stationeers' IC10; the device adapter is ONI's own

systems.name: Industrial chemistry: acids, bases, catalysts
systems.summary: Acids, bases and catalysts as native cell reactions exposed through the API: chlor-alkali, contact process, HCl, nitric acid, lime, neutralisation. The first piece, a Chlor-Alkali Cell, is built (Alpha 2 preview).
systems.divergence: Stationeers has no acids, bases, pH or corrosion: a new feature
systems.replaces: the Electrolyzer, Rust Deoxidizer and refinery recipes as hidden reactions

systems.name: 31 new elements
systems.summary: All 31 registered as data in Alpha 3, gameplay by tier: chemistry first, electronics and noble gases with Mod 5, inert ores later.
systems.divergence: To be registered per element in the chemistry design

systems.name: Smoker, soot deposits, liquid smoke
systems.summary: A smoker that pipes its smoke, soot that settles on tiles, buildings and duplicants, and liquid smoke; an idea by Kaz.
systems.divergence: Stationeers has no soot or deposits: a new feature

systems.name: Fermentation and distillation
systems.summary: Sugar ferments into ethanol, then distils as a physical process on the dissolved-gas machinery.
systems.divergence: Yeast-driven fermentation instead of Stationeers' fixed-recipe Fermenter
systems.replaces: the Ethanol Distiller's fixed wood-to-ethanol recipe

systems.name: Explosions, flashback, fire damage
systems.summary: Confined gas fires build pressure, a vent can burn back into its line, walls and pipes can fail, and duplicants react to fire.
systems.divergence: To be compared with Stationeers in its design

systems.name: Liquid waves
systems.summary: Liquid with depth pressure that moves with momentum instead of only levelling out (H5).
systems.divergence: none recorded in the doc read

systems.name: Atmosphere extraction and the liquid CO2 loop
systems.summary: Machines that extract and process Mars' air, and a liquid carbon dioxide refrigeration loop.
systems.divergence: none recorded in the doc read

systems.name: Planetary logistics
systems.summary: Landing pads, cargo, storage, a console for orders and trade between colonies, on the game's own rockets. A first trade route between planets is built (Alpha 2 preview).
systems.divergence: Built on the game's rockets rather than a new transport system

systems.name: Humidity: water vapour in the air
systems.summary: Water vapour as a partial pressure in the air: relative humidity, condensation on cold surfaces, and duplicant comfort.
systems.divergence: not yet compared with Stationeers

systems.name: Solid sulfur ignition
systems.summary: Solid sulfur ignites in air (about 505 K) and burns to sulfur dioxide, paying its melting heat on the way; the feed of a sulfur-burning acid plant.
systems.divergence: Stationeers has no sulfur: a new feature

systems.name: Boiling-point elevation of solutions
systems.summary: A liquid carrying a dissolved solute (caustic soda first) boils above the pure liquid's boiling point, by the real boiling-point elevation.
systems.divergence: Stationeers has no solutions: a new feature

systems.name: Water vapour-pressure curve refit
systems.summary: Water boils at 373.15 K at 1 atm on the fitted vapour-pressure curve, so pipe boiling and condensation land where real water does.
systems.divergence: none: the curve now matches real water at 1 atm

systems.name: Split burns: every oxidiser in proportion
systems.summary: A fire draws every oxidiser in its cell in proportion to what is there, instead of one oxidiser at a time.
systems.divergence: Stationeers draws the oxidiser from the whole mixture; we now do the same

systems.name: Vanadinite at the Metal Refinery
systems.summary: Vanadinite, a new ore, refines into Lead and vanadium pentoxide (V2O5) at the Metal Refinery.
systems.divergence: Stationeers has no vanadium: a new feature
systems.replaces: the Metal Refinery's fixed ore-to-metal recipe

systems.name: Screen effects: camera post-process hook
systems.summary: A framework hook for camera post-process effects, with the spacetime-warp effect as the first user (FxSandbox).
systems.divergence: none: a rendering feature, not a simulation change

systems.name: Sublimation and desorption by vapour pressure
systems.summary: A solid gives off gas at a rate set by its vapour pressure against the partial pressure above it, instead of a fixed per-element rate: the Sublimation Station, exposed Oxylite, Bleach Stone and Mars' carbon dioxide frost.
systems.divergence: Matches Stationeers: off-gassing follows the same vapour-pressure curve form as phase change; with the feature off the game's fixed-rate sublimation is reproduced exactly
systems.replaces: the fixed per-element sublimation rate, and the Sublimation Station's fixed recipe

systems.name: Bio-kinetics: one rate law for living things
systems.summary: Organisms in cells grow and work by one rate law (cardinal temperatures, substrate, oxygen with an aerobic or anaerobic branch, inhibition), carried as germs; compost, biogas and the fermentation yeast share it.
systems.divergence: Stationeers' fermenter gives fixed products after a fixed time; here organisms follow a rate law in temperature, food, oxygen and inhibitors, and their heat is the reaction's own
systems.replaces: fixed-rate recipes in the Compost, the Fertilizer Synthesizer's methane and the Algae Terrarium

systems.name: Porous flow through granular beds
systems.summary: Liquid moves through a permeable granular cell and leaves what it carries behind, so a sand bed filters, loads up and slows; the Water Sieve, Sludge Press and a membrane Desalinator ride it. Scope first, build after.
systems.divergence: A new capability: liquid flowing through a permeable solid cell, which neither ONI nor Stationeers has; Stationeers' water filter is a consumable part of the device
systems.replaces: the Water Sieve's fixed recipe (and later the Sludge Press's)

systems.name: Photosynthesis
systems.summary: Bio-kinetics with a light term: algae and later plants turn carbon dioxide and water into biomass and oxygen under light, by real stoichiometry.
systems.divergence: Expected to match Stationeers' plants, which trade carbon dioxide for oxygen under light; not yet compared in detail

systems.name: Melt and pour
systems.summary: A building heats stored solids through their real melting point, pays the latent heat, and pours the liquid into a cell or pipe; starts inside the Glass Forge.
systems.divergence: Matches Stationeers' furnaces, heated by burning fuel inside and paying the melt's energy; the product is a poured liquid because ONI elements carry their state
